title: Instrument Verification Bench Service Window
summary: Temporary coordination order for routine service and verification work at a general instrument bench.

sections.title: ORDER CONTROL
sections.body:
**Order no.:** OPS-2601

**Issuing division:** Laboratory Operations

**Effective:** 2026-08-25 / opening shift

**Expiration:** Release of the reserved bench following completion of the service list

**Issuing authority:** Operations Coordinator (role)

**Distribution:** Instrumentation and affected bench users

sections.title: PURPOSE
sections.body:
**Operational requirement:** Reserve one general verification bench for scheduled inspection, cable review, and reference-check activity.

**Reason:** Consolidating routine service tasks reduces repeated setup and keeps ordinary project work on available benches.

**Desired end state:** Bench returned to normal scheduling with service entries reconciled.

sections.title: DIRECTED ACTIONS
sections.body:
**Personnel affected:** Instrumentation staff and scheduled bench users.

**Required action:** Check the current bench schedule before setup; route verification work to the reserved position; retain ordinary service records.

**Prohibited action:** Do not relocate active project material into the service area.

**Record to maintain:** Equipment service and verification log.

sections.title: AUTHORITY & TERMINATION
sections.body:
**Exceptions authorized by:** Operations Coordinator (role).

**Automatic termination:** Completion of the scheduled verification list and bench-release check.

**Extension requires:** Updated service window and affected-user notice.

**Order status:** Active.

sections.title: SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS / SHIFT NOTES
sections.body: Keep temporary service labels with the applicable instrument. Leave unrelated project schedules unchanged. Record unresolved items for the next ordinary service interval.

sections.title: ISSUER / RECEIVING SUPERVISOR ACKNOWLEDGMENT
sections.body: Laboratory Operations issued the coordination order. Instrumentation supervision acknowledged the service window by role.
